integrity: Finite checker is ancillary and does not prove the infinite case; symbolic face and semigroup proof is supplied; independent review is not asserted.

scientific_limitations.domain: Simple cycle symmetric-edge polytopes and the toric variety of the fan over their faces; root lattice; algebraically closed field of arbitrary characteristic.
scientific_limitations.new_scope: For all even cycle lengths at least four, exact count and isolated support, complete local rank-one determinantal charts, multiplicities and local class groups.
scientific_limitations.previously_known: Odd-cycle smoothness and even-cycle global nonsmoothness, including Higashitani Corollary 2.3, are cited rather than claimed original.
scientific_limitations.unproved_or_not_claimed: No result for other graphs or normal-fan toric varieties; no proof of uniqueness among published mathematics; no independent external validation.

title: Isolated Segre cones on the Fano toric varieties of even cycle symmetric-edge polytopes
